canonical_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (cyans (find-color g 8))
                (rmin (min-list (map fst cyans)))
                (rmax (max-list (map fst cyans)))
                (cmin (min-list (map snd cyans)))
                (cmax (max-list (map snd cyans)))
                (dots (reduce (lambda (acc c)
                                (append acc
                                        (map (lambda (p) (list (fst p) (snd p) c))
                                             (find-color g c))))
                              (list)
                              (list 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 9))))
           (reduce (lambda (acc dot)
                     (let* ((r (fst dot))
                            (c (nth dot 1))
                            (color (nth dot 2)))
                       (cond
                         ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax)) (if (< c cmin)
                               (set-cell acc r cmin color)
                               (set-cell acc r cmax color)))
                         ((and (>= c cmin) (<= c cmax)) (if (< r rmin)
                               (set-cell acc rmin c color)
                               (set-cell acc rmax c color)))
                         (else acc))))
                   g
                   dots))))
rival_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (cyans (find-color g 8))
                (rmin (min-list (map fst cyans)))
                (rmax (max-list (map fst cyans)))
                (cmin (min-list (map snd cyans)))
                (cmax (max-list (map snd cyans)))
                (dots (reduce (lambda (acc c)
                                (append acc
                                        (map (lambda (p) (list (fst p) (snd p) c))
                                             (find-color g c))))
                              (list)
                              (list 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 9))))
           (reduce (lambda (acc dot)
                     (let* ((r (fst dot))
                            (c (nth dot 1))
                            (color (nth dot 2)))
                       (cond
                         ((and (> r 0) (< r (- h 1)) (> c 0) (< c (- w 1))) acc)
                         ((and (>= r rmin) (<= r rmax)) (if (< c cmin)
                               (set-cell acc r cmin color)
                               (set-cell acc r cmax color)))
                         ((and (>= c cmin) (<= c cmax)) (if (< r rmin)
                               (set-cell acc rmin c color)
                               (set-cell acc rmax c color)))
                         (else acc))))
                   g
                   dots))))
